selected_script.angle: Real-life bathroom drain clog frustration resolved by a quick-install silicone protective barrier
selected_script.hook: Tired of dealing with gross, clogged shower drains?

usage_steps_used: Clean and wipe dry the area around the drain opening
Place the Hair Catcher directly over the drain opening
Press down firmly on the corner suction cups
Use shower as usual and lift/remove caught hair from the dome as needed

script_record.pain_point: Dirty water pooling up and messy hair clogs in the shower drain
script_record.conflict_hook: Tired of dealing with gross, clogged shower drains?
script_record.product_solution: Direct placement of the Kitsch grey silicone hair catcher over the flat drain

timeline.scene: Close-up POV of water pooling in a shower with hair clogging the open metal drain grate.
A hand wipes dry the smooth surface around the drain, places the Kitsch grey silicone hair catcher directly over the opening, and presses down firmly on the four corner suction cups.
Water flows smoothly through the perforated grid of the catcher while hair gets trapped on the grey silicone dome.
The catcher is shown anchored flat over a bathtub drain, catching soapy water and hair seamlessly.
Hand easily lifts and removes the accumulated hair from the top dome of the catcher, keeping the drain clean.
Text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.' over a clean bathroom scene.

script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use.
